<!-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FILE      rossmann_decomposition.Rmd
  PURPOSE   Puts numbers on the three parts of Equation (1),
            y_{s,t} = mu_s + delta_{s,t} + u_{s,t}, on the Stage 1 holdout.
            mu_s      : the store's training mean.
            delta_s,t : the forecast minus mu_s, for a forecast that uses a given
                        information set F (weekly means, the full no-lag features,
                        or the features plus recent sales).
            u_s,t     : actual sales minus that forecast.
            delta depends on F by definition, so it is reported for each F.
            The best forecast gives the closest available estimate: its delta
            is a lower bound on the true predictable part and its u an upper
            bound on the true residual.
  INPUTS    train.csv, store.csv, rossmann_stages2_4.Rmd (pipeline chunk only)
  OUTPUTS   thesis_tables/decomposition.csv          (one row per information set)
            thesis_tables/decomposition_store1.csv   (daily values for Store 1)
  RUNTIME   Two LightGBM fits (about 10 to 30 minutes). LightGBM is seeded, so
            the results are reproducible. No XGBoost is used.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Pipeline

```{r pipeline}
# The code of the pipeline chunk of rossmann_stages2_4.Rmd, so data, features,
# split and model settings are exactly those of Stages 1 to 4.
lines <- readLines("rossmann_stages2_4.Rmd")
start <- grep("^```\\{r pipeline", lines)[1]
end   <- start + which(grepl("^```\\s*$", lines[(start + 1):length(lines)]))[1]
eval(parse(text = lines[(start + 1):(end - 1)]), envir = globalenv())
```

# Forecasts under three information sets

```{r fits}
sp <- split_data(df, FEAT_S1)                       # Stage 1 holdout, no lags
te <- sp$test %>% select(Store, Date, Sales)

# mu: the store's training mean (the Store-mean baseline)
mu <- sp$train %>% group_by(Store) %>% summarise(mu = mean(Sales), .groups = "drop")
te <- te %>% left_join(mu, by = "Store")

# F1 weekly: store x day-of-week means (the Store-DOW baseline)
dow <- sp$train %>% group_by(Store, DayOfWeek) %>% summarise(f = mean(Sales), .groups = "drop")
te$f_weekly <- sp$test %>% left_join(dow, by = c("Store", "DayOfWeek")) %>% pull(f)
te$f_weekly <- coalesce(te$f_weekly, te$mu)

# F2 full no-lag features: LightGBM as in Stage 1
fit2 <- run_lightgbm(sp, return_model = TRUE)
te$f_features <- predict(fit2$model, sp$X_test)

# F3 features plus recent sales (lags, one-step updating): LightGBM as in Stage 3
df_lags <- df %>% group_by(Store) %>% arrange(Date) %>% group_modify(~ add_lag_features(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(!is.na(lag28), !is.na(roll28_mean))
sp3  <- split_data(df_lags, FEAT_S3)
fit3 <- run_lightgbm(sp3, return_model = TRUE)
te <- te %>% left_join(sp3$test %>% select(Store, Date) %>% mutate(f_lags = predict(fit3$model, sp3$X_test)),
                       by = c("Store", "Date"))

c(rows = nrow(te), missing_lag_forecasts = sum(is.na(te$f_lags)),
  rmse_features = sqrt(mean((te$Sales - te$f_features)^2)),
  rmse_lags     = sqrt(mean((te$Sales - te$f_lags)^2, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

# Decomposition

For every test store-day, `y - mu = delta + u` holds exactly, so the mean squared
departure from the store level splits into a delta part, a u part and a cross
term. `share_delta` is the share of that departure the information set explains.

```{r decomp}
te <- te %>% filter(!is.na(f_lags))                 # same rows for all three sets
dev <- te$Sales - te$mu
msq_dev <- mean(dev^2)
one <- function(label, f) {
  delta <- f - te$mu; u <- te$Sales - f
  tibble(Information_set = label,
         mu_sd_across_stores = sd(mu$mu),
         mu_mean = mean(te$mu),
         departure_rms = sqrt(msq_dev),
         delta_rms = sqrt(mean(delta^2)),
         u_rms     = sqrt(mean(u^2)),
         cross_term = 2 * mean(delta * u),
         share_delta = 1 - mean(u^2) / msq_dev)
}
decomp <- bind_rows(one("Weekly (Store-DOW)", te$f_weekly),
                    one("Calendar, store, promotion (LightGBM)", te$f_features),
                    one("Plus recent sales (LightGBM, lags)", te$f_lags)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))
decomp

dir.create("thesis_tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(decomp, "thesis_tables/decomposition.csv")
```

# One store, day by day

```{r store1}
s1 <- te %>% filter(Store == 1) %>% arrange(Date) %>%
  transmute(Date, Sales, mu, delta = f_lags - mu, u = Sales - f_lags)
s1
write_csv(s1, "thesis_tables/decomposition_store1.csv")
```
